metaDescription: Free online HTML Minifier. Compress HTML code.
intro: Use our free online HTML Minifier tool. It compresses HTML code based on your inputs.
whatIs: The HTML Minifier is an online utility that compresses HTML code. It processes your raw HTML and provides HTML without whitespace or comments.
howToUse: Enter your raw HTML into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like minified HTML.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate HTML without whitespace or comments.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your raw HTML. It instantly processes the data to output HTML without whitespace or comments.
workedExample: For example: Turns multi-line HTML into a single long string.
resultInterpretation: The result represents HTML without whitespace or comments. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing raw HTML on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Minified code is extremely difficult for humans to read.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Does it change how the page looks?
faq.answer: No, browsers ignore the removed whitespace.

faq.question: Is the HTML Minifier free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our HTML Minifier is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
